verdict.rationale: The pack never documents custom fields or configurable workflow statuses. The closest items are Power-Up developer primitives (card badges, card-back buttons), a generic automation claim, list color changes, and a community user's own board-per-stage arrangement. These are developer building blocks, adjacent features, or user-side workarounds, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process
